responsibility: Implements C++ linkage mangling for the D front end using the Itanium C++ ABI scheme, plus target hook integration for ABI-specific special cases. It traverses D symbols, types, template instances, parameters, and expressions to emit C++-visible mangled names with substitution tracking, handles namespaces, classes, enums, cv-qualifiers, template arguments, function encodings, and special runtime names such as typeinfo and thunks, and exposes the public entry points used when D declarations have `extern(C++)` linkage.
